description: Source code for a C program that converts TRX firmware images to U.S. Robotics firmware images by adding a header, including functions for CRC calculation, file processing, and main execution logic.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a buffer of bytes.

methods.name: trx2usr
methods.description: Converts a TRX firmware image to a U.S. Robotics firmware image by prepending a header and updating CRC.
